title: Chef and Bipartite Graphs
source_topic: CodeChef / ACM-ICPC India Regionals, Online Preliminary Round 2016
statement: Chef is very interested in studying biparite graphs. Today he wants to construct a bipartite graph with n vertices each, on the two parts, and with total number of edges equal to m . The vertices on the left are numbered from 1 to n . And the vertices on the right are also numbered from 1 to n .
